metadata.title: Jarwiz product launch kanban
metadata.baseline: Current Jarwiz working tree, including existing modified and untracked product modules. No worktree reset or inferred completion.
metadata.goal: Prepare a real closed-beta product through complete tested workflows, then expand feature coverage.
metadata.launchDecision: Implementation wave delivered. Do not admit a cohort until configured provider/OAuth, hosted durability/recovery, licensing and operational acceptance pass.
workingPolicy: Feature crews implement independent slices with explicit file ownership.
Deterministic tests establish local evidence. A slice moves to Done only after its own acceptance review; broader live release gates remain separate.
Done requires recorded acceptance evidence and review; marketing demonstrations are not release evidence.
The user authorized private staging deployment and release rehearsal on 2026-11-21. Hosting access and test configuration are still required; cohort admission and external email are not automatic.
Model credentials, provider account access, hosting, licensing and operating ownership are external prerequisites.
metadata.activeBuild: ChatGPT local subscription implementation is in review. Final verification: 214 unit passes, one optional skip, eight targeted browser checks, successful typechecks/builds and actual local-server smoke. Live subscription acceptance, hosted enrollment and Claude approval remain separate blockers.

boardVerification.result: Passed browser checks at 1440, 1024, 390 and 320px: active/full view counts, six columns, filters, detail rail/Escape, gate expansion, refresh, containment and no page overflow.

backlogAudit.note: All original feature epics are represented. No duplicate parity epics were added. Current provider implementation evidence was reconciled; actual release blockers and acceptance reviews remain distinct from unstarted feature work.

publicKanbanSync.note: GitHub authentication restored. This update publishes the previously queued release rehearsal and the current personal-subscription tasks; it does not deploy the product.
